# @tscad/viewer

[![NPM Version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@tscad/viewer)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@tscad/viewer) [![Homepage](https://img.shields.io/badge/docs-default)](https://tscad.vercel.app)

A viewer for tscad models

<!-- #endregion header -->

A three.js viewer for models rendered by `@tscad/kernel`: B-rep edges as crisp outlines, a
parameter form generated from the model's JSON Schema, analysis plugin reports, and errors with
source links. It mounts into any element and keeps its styles scoped to it.

```ts
import { createViewer } from '@tscad/viewer';
import '@tscad/viewer/style.css';

const viewer = createViewer(document.querySelector('#viewer')!, {
  onParams: (values) => render(values), // re-render with the new parameter values
  theme: 'auto', // or 'light' / 'dark'
});

await viewer.showModel(glb); // kernel.render(model, 'glb')
viewer.showParameters(schema, values);
```

`tscad dev` serves the preview page (`@tscad/viewer/preview.html`), which feeds the viewer over a
WebSocket; the docs playground feeds it from a Web Worker running the wasm kernel.
